slice: Natural conversation round 34: 'will you forget me?' answered warmly, never with buffer/session implementation-speak

before.are you going to forget me?: my memory is built into how I process things — I don't have a separate 'forget' button or a temporary buffer that clears.

after.are you going to forget me?: Of course — I remember what you've shared, and I'm not going to forget you.
after.do you remember me?: Honestly, I don't have much on you yet — tell me a bit about yourself and I'll remember it.

mechanism: memory/forgetting questions route to a warm reassuring steer + fallback; buffer/session/process phrasings are forbidden and regenerated
